label: Correctness of the scoped epistemic judgment is fixed by the actual selective history
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred. Every scenario with the actual selective history agrees with the actual scenario on whether the judged content is correct. Constructivism (correctness constituted by attitudes the history fixes), functional accounts (correctness as truth-conduciveness in the environment the history responded to) and a necessitarian realism (correctness the same in every scenario) each supply it for different reasons.
